channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jeffrey Kessler | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jeffrey Kessler from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Michele Roberts on Jeffrey Kessler
item.description:
“I understand why you resolve something and avoid the risk of litigation, and I can’t say that Jeffrey [Kessler] hasn’t made a deal that’s in the best interest of those students. I just don’t like the deal, and I’d like to think I wouldn’t have cut that deal.”

Michele Roberts on Jeffrey Kessler, Jan 13, 2025. Source: Sportico.

item.title: Billy Hunter on Jeffrey Kessler, David Boies
item.description:
The NFLPA never got an ultimate ruling on whether the lockout or disclaimer were legal, but instead got a narrow ruling from the 8th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals that the federal district court did not have the authority to lift the lockout.

“I felt the combination of Boies and Kessler, from my perspective, would be an unbeatable team,”

Billy Hunter on Jeffrey Kessler, David Boies, Nov 14, 2011. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: David Stern on Jeffrey Kessler
item.description:
Stern on ESPN:

“Obviously, Mr. Kessler got his way and we're about to go into the nuclear winter of the NBA.”

David Stern on Jeffrey Kessler, Nov 14, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: David Stern on Jeffrey Kessler
item.description:
Stern then noted that the NBPA did not accept the NBA's offer as currently constructed.

“I think it's fair to say that, speaking on behalf of the union, [NBPA lawyer Jeffrey] Kessler rejected the mediator's recommendations and our proposal,”

David Stern on Jeffrey Kessler, Nov 6, 2011. Source: CBSSports.com.
